key_insight: EpiCoach turns wearable-based coaching into auditable N-of-1 science by requiring predictions before sessions and updating beliefs only from logged statistical evidence.
engineering_relevance: The system offers a design pattern for personalized health agents that connect mechanistic models, falsifiable predictions, constrained experiments and safety oversight.
method: Infer a digital twin from heart rate, GPS and altitude, modeling cardiac lag, fitness–fatigue dynamics and technical-descending skill.
Maintain an evidence-gated hypothesis registry with prospective probabilistic predictions and traceable belief updates.
Plan weekly training to maximize information gain within load and safety constraints, centered on two instrument rides.
evidence_signal: Evaluation used 18 months of one athlete’s data: replay beat standard forecasters on heart rate but not segment time, while the first three live weeks sealed 20 predictions, scored 14 and recorded two safety vetoes.
watch_item: Generalizability remains untested beyond one athlete, and the agentic loop matched rather than outperformed a static model in replay.
paper_title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
